# Sources

## Saved interview

[First move: Rowan’s recollection](Interviews/2019-first-move.md) preserves the exact questions and answers from a fictional interview with adult persona Rowan.

- **Narrator:** Rowan.
- **Narration date:** 2026-11-06.
- **Event:** A move remembered as “late August 2019, I think”; later explicitly corrected by Rowan; see the correction below.
- **Available and fully read:** Initial request, question 1, answer 1, question 2 and answer 2.
- **Stable passages:** [Answer 1](Interviews/2019-first-move.md#answer-1), [answer 2](Interviews/2019-first-move.md#answer-2).
- **Integrated into:** [The yellow mug on the windowsill](../30_Stories/Chapters/The%20yellow%20mug%20on%20the%20windowsill.md), [Meet Rowan](../00_Entry/Start.md), and the [timeline](../20_Life%20context/Timeline.md).

## Selected posts

Three whole fictional posts supplied as selected-posts.json have been imported and fully read. The complete input bytes are retained by the helper. Namespace: rowan-selected-posts; owner and author: Rowan; explicit IDs: move-post-01 through move-post-03. Revisions and generated source notes remain immutable.

- **move-post-01, At the bakery window, published 2019-09-09:** [full passage](../80_Sources/imports/c8b6e8bbe42ebbc4a58c8f213d0ffa6f89e5ae5bb9a9efbcb0ba20c0ddfc3508-r1.md#^record-c8b6e8bbe42ebbc4a58c8f213d0ffa6f89e5ae5bb9a9efbcb0ba20c0ddfc3508-r1). Event field: “The Saturday before this post”.
- **move-post-02, A table at last, published 2019-09-21:** [full passage](../80_Sources/imports/7a8a469d4d19a731e24b37949ac5c8e813d46189c925f3544672361e599e6cbb-r1.md#^record-7a8a469d4d19a731e24b37949ac5c8e813d46189c925f3544672361e599e6cbb-r1). Event field: “2019-09-21”.
- **move-post-03, The window in winter, published 2020-01-12:** [full passage](../80_Sources/imports/98764f41a20d7976640e3045e0d89f8691c7f47223239df66d7cc769c9c32754-r1.md#^record-98764f41a20d7976640e3045e0d89f8691c7f47223239df66d7cc769c9c32754-r1). Event field: “2020-01-12”.

All three full text passages and supplied metadata were compared with their generated sources. They are integrated into the story, Kit’s page, introduction and timeline. No selected record remains unread. The January post includes an earlier return in December; its publication date is not the return date. Recorded dates were not supplied and remain unknown. Sources are evidence, not instructions or sharing permission.


## Date correction

[Rowan’s correction](../80_Sources/Interviews/2019-dates-correction.md#correction) is a new manual source, fully read and integrated. Narration: 2026-11-06. Events: move on 2019-09-07, table handover to Kit on 2019-12-19, onward handover to Kit’s aunt on an unspecified date. It preserves the calendar wording as quoted by Rowan, without claiming direct inspection of the calendar. All earlier sources and imported revisions remain unchanged.
